description: 10 production-ready Conditional Access policies for Microsoft Entra ID. Import via Entra Admin Center or Microsoft Graph API.

policies.rationale: Legacy authentication protocols (IMAP, POP3, SMTP AUTH, older Office clients) do not support modern authentication and cannot enforce MFA. They are the most common vector for password-spray attacks.
policies.rolloutNote: Start in report-only mode for 7 days. Review sign-in logs filtered by 'Client App = Legacy Authentication Clients' before enforcing.

policies.rationale: Privileged accounts are the highest-value target. A compromised Global Admin account without MFA is a full tenant takeover.
policies.rolloutNote: No staged rollout needed for admin accounts - enable directly, but ensure break-glass accounts are excluded and tested first.

policies.displayName: CA003 - Require MFA for All Users
policies.rationale: Microsoft reports MFA blocks over 99.9% of account compromise attacks. This is the single highest-impact security control available.
policies.rolloutNote: Pair with the MFA Rollout Kit template for a phased 3-week communication plan. Do not enable before users have registered authentication methods.

policies.displayName: CA004 - Require Compliant or Hybrid Joined Device for Admins
policies.rationale: Restricts admin access to managed devices, preventing privileged sign-ins from unmanaged personal machines.
policies.rolloutNote: Requires Intune enrollment or hybrid Azure AD join to be functional first. Combine with the Intune Device Compliance Starter template.

policies.rationale: Identity Protection assigns a real-time risk score to sign-ins based on anomalous location, impossible travel, leaked credentials, and known malicious IP ranges. High-risk sign-ins should never be allowed through.
policies.rolloutNote: Requires Entra ID P2 (Identity Protection). If only P1 is available, skip this policy or substitute with sign-in frequency restrictions.

policies.displayName: CA006 - Require Password Change for Medium-Risk Users
policies.rationale: Users flagged with elevated risk (e.g. credentials found in a breach dump) should be forced to re-authenticate with MFA and change their password before continuing.
policies.rolloutNote: Requires Entra ID P2. Test with a single pilot user account before broad enablement.

policies.rationale: If the organization has no legitimate business presence in certain geographic regions, sign-ins originating from those locations are almost certainly malicious or VPN-obscured attacks.
policies.rolloutNote: Customer must define the 'HighRiskCountries' Named Location first based on their actual business footprint - this is a placeholder that must be customized per tenant. Never block countries where traveling employees may legitimately be.

policies.displayName: CA008 - Require Approved Client App for Mobile
policies.rationale: Prevents corporate data from being accessed through unmanaged third-party mail/file apps on personal mobile devices, forcing use of Microsoft's managed app ecosystem (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive mobile apps with App Protection Policies).
policies.rolloutNote: Pairs well with Intune App Protection Policies (MAM) for BYOD scenarios where full device enrollment is not desired.

policies.displayName: CA009 - Session Sign-In Frequency for Unmanaged Devices
policies.rationale: On unmanaged devices, sessions should expire faster and browsers should not persist sign-in state, reducing the window of opportunity if a device is shared or compromised.
policies.rolloutNote: Communicate to users in advance - this will require more frequent re-authentication on personal devices.

policies.displayName: CA010 - Terms of Use Acceptance for Guests
policies.rationale: External guest accounts (common in Teams and SharePoint sharing) represent an often-overlooked attack surface. Requiring MFA and explicit Terms of Use acceptance creates an audit trail and raises the bar for guest account abuse.
policies.rolloutNote: Requires a Terms of Use document to be configured in Entra ID under Identity Governance first. A generic template ToU is included as ca010-terms-of-use-template.docx in this package.

breakGlassAccountGuidance.recommendation: Create at least 2 cloud-only emergency access accounts excluded from ALL Conditional Access policies. Use 16+ character random passwords stored offline (physical safe). Monitor sign-ins to these accounts with high-priority alerts. Microsoft Learn reference: 'Manage emergency access accounts in Microsoft Entra ID'.

ms365dscMapping.note: Each policy object above maps directly to an AADConditionalAccessPolicy resource block. Phase 2 export will generate a complete .ps1 DSC configuration file from this JSON. Not included in Phase 1 - manual import via Entra Admin Center or Microsoft Graph API required.
